integrity: The full all-order result is established analytically; finite computation is a consistency check, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns unweighted complex Jordan shifts and \(n\ge4\) with real \(q\in[0,1]\); it does not classify weighted or arbitrary nilpotents. Full text of Li--Nakazato (1998) was unavailable; an unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Quadratic exit from the norm plateau for \(q\)-numerical radii of Jordan shifts
